name: Sophie
source:
The daughter of the president of a paper manufacturing company called "Otama's Charm" in Ehime Prefecture.
She lives without any inconvenience, so she's a little naive.
However, one day, his father made a debt of 10 billion yen at the casino, and the family became desperate of financial situation.
